classification.method: Aggregate provenance (no per-G-record OSM id on disc). land-local = type-288 count in pinned spool cell (1755,591). overlap-share-in = G_parent_288 - spool_local_288 (lower bound of shapes shared in by overlap). marine-share-in = 0: vocab rule for 288 is L0 catch-all match{} (bg_type.json), not a marine-specific class; marine parks that map to 288 are a subset of catch-all, not separable without OSM tags on disc. encoder-synthesised = 0 under this method (no evidence of inventing 288 without spool).
classification.note_vs_design_assumption_1: DESIGN Assumption 1 expected mostly marine-relation spill. Re-measure shows 98.3138% of parent type-288 is already present as local spool catch-all ways; only 148 (1.6862%) are overlap share-ins. Marine-specific spill is not the dominant class.

bytes_freed_if_288_absent_estimate.method: Vertex-count proxy from plan-42 trim dump for sub (2,1). Type-288 accounts for nearly all geometry verts in the overflowing sub; sibling leaves with roads and far fewer 288 fit well under the frame cap. Counterfactual: absent the pre-shrink 6,628 type-288 items, the 207 roads would not trigger dv_shrink fallback (frame would be comparable to other sub-leaves that retain roads).

kind_order_pressure.counterfactual: If type-288 backgrounds were absent from this sub-cell, dv_shrink would not need to cut the 207 roads to free capacity (plan 42 proven cause chain). Kind-order only matters because catch-all 288 fills the frame first.
